question: How many sacred places has the speaker declared to the listener?
premises: Aṣṭottaraśataṃ specifies one hundred and eight.
Mayā identifies the speaker as the declarer.
Te identifies the listener as recipient.
Parikīrtitam indicates they have been declared.
inference: The speaker has declared one hundred and eight sacred places to the listener.
plain_english: I have declared to you one hundred and eight sacred places.
